unit.why: A short anecdote: the master, while visiting a village, tells how his teacher of Medzhybizh saw that some notables who came to greet him had been reincarnated as pigs, and says the same holds for the people present.

stories.start_quote: פ״א היה מרן ז״ל בכפר א׳
stories.summary_en: While visiting a village where many came to greet him, the master told how his teacher in Medzhybizh saw that some dignitaries welcoming him had been pigs in a previous incarnation, and added that the same was true of some who had come to greet him now.

quotes: היו בתוכם אנשים שהיו קודם לידתם מגולגלים בחזירים
tags.why: The point is the prior incarnation of the notables as pigs.

quotes: גם באנשים ההמה שהיו בכאן היה ג״כ כן
tags.why: Both tsaddikim discern the hidden past incarnations of the people before them.

quotes: פ״א היה מרן ז״ל בכפר א׳
tags.why: The scene is set during the master's stay in a village.

quotes: באו אנשים מכובדים לקבל פנ מורו ורבו ממעזבוז
tags.why: Crowds and notables come to greet the tsaddik.

quotes: וסיפר אח״כ כי פ״א באו אנשים מכובדים
tags.why: The master narrates a story about his own teacher.
The master's ability is modelled on, and set beside, his teacher's; the relationship is only in the background.
The respected townsmen are revealed to have had a debased former incarnation.

missing_concepts: reincarnation into animals (gilgul in beasts) as a mark of a low soul
the hidden spiritual status of communal notables (nikhbadei ha-ir)
